title: No test takes, changes or removes a member photo on the Add member screen
what: The photo part of Add member (Take photo, the camera sheet, Use photo, Change photo, Remove, and the red 'added, but the photo was not saved' banner) is never driven on screen. Only the picture-shrinking rules and the server's photo store are tested. Also the journey's wrong-file words differ from the app's ('That file is not a photo...').
expected: A browser test with a fake camera takes a photo, changes it, removes it, and fails the photo save, checking the banner, the single Close button and that the member is saved once; another checks the photo row is hidden for a gym kept only in the browser.
how_often: every member added with a photo
fix_line: Add one browser test of the photo steps with a fake camera, including a failed photo save

title: The 'already has this number, archived' banner on Add member is never tested
what: Typing an archived member's number on Add member should show a red banner with 'Bring them back' and 'Open their page'. No test types such a number in the form, taps either button, changes the number to clear the banner, or fails the bring-back with the internet off. The only archived test goes through a different sheet on Enquiries.
expected: A browser test archives a member, types their number on Add member, checks the banner, brings them back once (no new member, name not overwritten), and checks Open their page does not un-archive.
fix_line: Add a browser test for the archived-number banner and both its buttons

title: The Add member error words, Saving button and Cancel are never checked on screen
what: Only the rule behind the form is tested: which box is wrong. No test shows the words under Email, Date of birth, a short mobile or an 81-letter name, that the first wrong box is scrolled to, that the button reads 'Saving…' and cannot be pressed twice, or that Cancel saves nothing and the next open is empty.
expected: A browser test presses Add member with each wrong box and reads the words, checks the Saving state, and cancels a filled form then reopens it empty.
how_often: every wrong entry on Add member
fix_line: Add one browser test for the error words, the Saving state and Cancel

title: Editing a member is never checked for the archived note, a clashing number or a kept photo
what: Edit member is opened by tests only to tick a pass or the every-branch box. No test edits a name, gives a number another member has, opens an archived member to see the 'This member is archived' note, or checks the photo, plan and dues stay after a save.
expected: A browser test edits name and number, hits the duplicate-number words, edits an archived member and checks they stay archived and off the list, and checks the photo and plan survive.
fix_line: Add a browser test of Edit member covering the archived note and a clashing number

title: No test checks what the front desk sees on the member forms
what: Desk logins add members in two tests, but only by name and number through the shared helper. Nothing checks the 'Can train at every branch' box is hidden from a desk login, nor any enquiry, online-join, pass or batch path signed in as the desk.
expected: A browser test signed in as the desk in a gym with two branches opens Add member and Edit member and checks the every-branch box is absent, then adds a member from an enquiry.
fix_line: Add a desk-login browser test of Add and Edit member in a two-branch gym

title: Tests require another branch to find a member who is not allowed there
what: The journey says a member without the every-branch tick must not be findable by mobile at another branch's desk. The tests require the opposite: the other branch finds him, sees his first name and home branch, and is told his plan is for that branch only.
expected: Decide which is right. If the desk should be told, fix the journey; if not, the lookup should answer nobody for an unticked member and the tests should say so.
how_often: every look-up of a one-branch member at another branch
fix_line: Pick one rule for unticked members at other branches and make the journey and tests agree

title: Turning off 'train at every branch', and ticking it on Add member, are never tested
what: The only test ticks the box on Edit member. Nothing ticks it on Add member, reopens a member to see it still ticked, unticks it, or checks the member is then refused at the other branch.
expected: A browser test ticks on Add member, reopens and sees the tick, unticks, and checks the other branch can no longer check the member in.
how_often: whenever a member's branch access is taken away
fix_line: Extend the branch check-in test to untick the box and retry the check-in

title: The batch chips on the member form are never seen by a test
what: Only the batch rules are tested (spelling, counting, 40-letter limit). No test shows the chip row, picks a chip, uses '+ New batch', reads the 40-letter words, or sees the batch under the member's name.
expected: A browser test adds two members to a batch, checks the chip with its count, the new-batch box and its words, and that removing the last member's batch removes the chip.
how_often: every member added to a batch
fix_line: Add a browser test of the batch chips on Add and Edit member

title: Making an enquiry a member is untested when the number is taken or the form is cancelled
what: No test opens Add as member on an enquiry whose number belongs to a member who is not archived (the 'is already a member' sheet with 'Mark joined and open'), or cancels the prefilled form and checks the enquiry is still open. The app-members tab test checks only that the form opens, not what it is filled with.
expected: Browser tests for the taken-number sheet and its Cancel, a cancelled enquiry form, and the app-member prefill with +91.
how_often: whenever a known person enquires again
fix_line: Add browser tests for the taken-number sheet and a cancelled enquiry form

title: A pass member's break and restart, and '+ Other company', are never tested on screen
what: The rules keep the first pass day and clear it on untick, but no browser test reopens a pass member to see the tick and company, unticks and re-ticks, types a company through '+ Other company', or checks past pass visits stay counted.
expected: A browser test edits a FITPASS member: sees the tick, unticks, re-ticks, and checks the start day and past visits; another types 'fit pass' under Other company and finds one FITPASS chip.
how_often: whenever a pass member stops or restarts
fix_line: Extend the pass browser test with untick, re-tick and Other company
